read_scope.prior_observation_scope: All four rows, all18 listed terminal witnesses, the one separately recorded join, all region/connection/coverage/count/uncertainty records read as text. No image validation.

current_source_qualification.scope: Names/source/unit scope only; no image view or morphology coding
Names/source/unit scope only; no image view or morphology coding

fixed_scope.four_entry_scope: Reuse exact old whole-entry definitions; no part selected because it matches a name.

failure_to_preserve.observed_old_result: K01/K02/K03/K04 terminal witnessed lower counts6/6/2/4; all whole-entry terminal/join upper and exact totals null. One local three-arm join recorded in K03. These are old records, not new codes.
failure_to_preserve.cause: A visible carrier can end in a region that itself bears finer channels; broad painted interiors do not expose routing. Flat terminal totals mix structural levels and demand nonexistent complete decomposition.
failure_to_preserve.new_target: Finite capped counts of explicitly local relation motifs; broad regions may remain opaque and complete trees are never required.

opaque_region.definition: A visibly bounded or candidate-envelope region in which separate internal routes cannot be traced. Store region/envelope alternatives and visible boundary ports; no hidden skeleton, biological organ label or forced main axis.
opaque_region.not_required: Exact segmentation, complete boundary pixel mask, internal routing or finite count of invisible subparts.

port.definition: Coordinate-supported place where one visible passage meets a region, end-zone or visible joining area. A port is an incidence observation, not proof that all ports on a broad region meet internally.
port.evidence: Source coordinate interval/box, incident passage ID, continuous/contact/overlap status and view receipt.

carrier.definition: A separately traceable nonbranching passage between a body/join port and a distal end-zone. Roles are local incidence roles, not thickness classes or leaf/root/stem assignments. A bare terminal passage is allowed as a carrier with a bare end-zone. Two-end orientation is fixed only by observed body/join versus end-zone relation; if both directions or different levels are plausible retain alternatives.
carrier.evidence: Original-coordinate polyline plus two separated transverse boundary witness segments or explicit single-stroke evidence. No split at colour/width change alone.

end_zone.definition: A local distal cap or first visibly delimited attachment/fan region reached along that carrier. It may be a free cap or support directly outgoing channels; it is not automatically a free terminal. An arbitrary cut through a uniform passage is not a new end-zone.
end_zone.boundary_rule: Give the cap/transition/first local branching evidence that distinguishes this zone; if more than one grouping is plausible retain all supported candidates. Unbounded ambiguity is recorded as unresolved, not forced into one zone.

direct_child_channel.definition: A separately witnessed passage from a port of the end-zone to a visible free end, without an intervening visible branch or another unresolved region. Fine means direct child at this local level, not a numerical width cutoff. Passages that branch or disappear before a free end remain unresolved for this child category.
direct_child_channel.evidence: Own free-end box, whole visible path and two transverse boundary witnesses or single-stroke record. Each physical trace ID once; shared tail belongs to one shared edge.

visible_join.definition: One local visible junction with at least three separate channel arms and actual continuity witnesses; outlined edges do not count as separate arms. A broad region with several ports is not a join unless a bounded local junction is independently visible.

minimal_representation.non_requirement: This incidence table may be disconnected and can have alternative parents or overlaps. It is not a required full tree or a biological hierarchy. A region may have higher-level and lower-level roles only with separately witnessed incidences; no recursive hidden branching is inferred.

coordinate_and_coverage.coordinates: Original source x/y plus explicit boxes/polylines/cross-section endpoints; normalized fixed-context coordinates only for navigation. No main-axis fitting, rotation, reflection or pairwise alignment.
coordinate_and_coverage.eight_pixel_rule: The old8px padding is not calibrated error. Do not carry it into certified inequality, boundary coverage or direction decisions. New coordinate alternatives must be justified locally; otherwise directional relation remains unknown and is excluded from the primary score.
coordinate_and_coverage.coverage: Track viewed viewport, inspected relevant boundary/region and individually recorded structures separately. A full viewport display is not exhaustive fine-detail coverage. Store explicit unreviewed residual and unresolved residual, with the motif classes each could affect.
prohibited: Pixel masks or exact segmentation claims
New labels or biological organ hypotheses
Treating a generated crop as an actual view

coordinates.motif: Distinct carrier-end-zone units with exactly zero direct free-ending child channels. Local end-zone perimeter/attachments must be sufficiently inspected to rule out a child; not merely no child recorded.
Distinct carrier-end-zone units with exactly one direct free-ending child channel. One positive witness plus local coverage ruling out a second; one witnessed child alone is not enough.
Distinct carrier-end-zone units with at least two mutually compatible, distinct direct free-ending child channels. Two suffice even if more children remain unresolved.
Distinct locally visible joining regions with at least three independent continuous arms; broad body ports alone excluded.

primary_signature.meaning: z_k=min(N_k,2); state2 means two-or-more, not exactlytwo. Threshold2 is a fixed saturation level, not an observed feature-tuning parameter. All four coordinates have equal primary weight.
primary_signature.why_finite: Each entry has at most3^4=81 capped signatures even when whole-entry raw totals have no finite upper bound. Unknown raw total is not treated as infinity or a known number.
primary_signature.positive_witness_rule: Two compatible distinct motifs of one class certify state2 without a complete entry inventory. One certifies only lower bound1 unless additional instances are ruled out. Zero requires complete relevant search/coverage for that class.
primary_signature.residual_rule: If an unreviewed or unresolved region could contain more motifs of classk, retain the possible higher capped states. A completely unresolved coordinate remains{0,1,2}. ClassQ0/Q1 lower witnesses require their local absence/uniqueness condition independently of global coverage.
primary_signature.non_independence: Q0/Q1/Q2 for the same carrier-end-zone unit are mutually exclusive. A junction and a carrier-end-zone may involve shared material, so coordinate dimensions are not independent measurements.

candidate_dependencies.canonical_ids: Reuse a canonical physical trace/zone/port ID in all references and pairs. Distinct record IDs do not alone prove distinct structures.
constraints: Alternative same/duplicate IDs merge before counts.
A child belongs to its selected zone/port in one complete interpretation; do not give it to both alternatives.
Shared tails and candidate equivalent zones cannot each raise lower counts.
One carrier-end-zone contributes to exactly one ofQ0/Q1/Q2 when its child count category is established.
If a local role/orientation is ambiguous, choose one full supported alternative for all four coordinates and all pair comparisons.
candidate_dependencies.admissible_entry_set: Represent A_i subset of{0,1,2}^4 from all admissible complete local interpretations plus explicit residual uncertainty. Keep witness/constraint references for each signature or each restriction. Preserve disjunctions; do not independently project and recombine coordinates as if all combinations were proven feasible.
candidate_dependencies.safe_relaxation: If residual structure cannot be fully enumerated, a documented superset of capped signatures may be used for conservative outer bounds. Retain every known alias/exclusion/ownership constraint; do not mark these outer witnesses as jointly realizable drawings. An empty set is an input conflict and stops calculation, never recoded unknown.
candidate_dependencies.no_candidate_cherry_pick: A whole entry signature/interpretation is fixed across all its incident pairs. No independent pairwise best graph match; no feature-specific best local partition.

one_primary_quantity.contrast: H_b=(1/|M_b|) sum_{s in M_b}[mean_{(i,j) in P_s,b}S(i,j)-mean_{(i,j) in N_s,b}S(i,j)], where s is a fixed cross-manuscript source-pair stratum and M_b contains strata with both classes under frozen naming branchb.
one_primary_quantity.weights: Equal mixed source-pair strata; within each class equal eligible pairs; four signature coordinates equal. No threshold, coordinate or stratum selected using scores.
one_primary_quantity.naming_and_pair_freeze: Use fixed_naming_branches and all15 roles specified here from frozen source_qualification_v1 and its wording correction. Freeze before new coding. Report primary conditional H, undefined strict branch, and prespecified matched-four sensitivity without selecting by sign.
one_primary_quantity.source_dependence: Same-manuscript or same-source-image pairs are descriptive only. If two entries reuse the same physical drawing, share its canonical state; do not count duplicate references as independent source evidence. Physical-leaf aliases retained.
one_primary_quantity.undefined: If no mixed eligible cross-manuscript stratum exists, H_b=null. Undefined source unit blocks that unit-level score; do not delete the unit to rescue a full-six claim. All six record rows and all15 pair roles remain reported.
one_primary_quantity.bounds: For each frozen name branch and full admissible candidate interpretation, optimize the entire H_b jointly over all entry signatures with sharing; then envelope over admissible complete candidates. Keep lower/upper witness signatures, per-feature and per-stratum contributions, pair denominators, candidate IDs and residual-superset status. Pairwise extrema are not aggregated as jointly attainable.
one_primary_quantity.computational_note: Use finite signature sets plus exact enumeration/variable elimination or a verified global optimization. In a bipartite two-manuscript graph, enumerate one side and optimize each opposite entry conditional on it; preserve each entry full4-coordinate signature. No per-coordinate separability assumption. If a resource budget is exceeded, report computation unresolved or proved conservative bounds, never heuristic extrema as exact. For the conditional5-entry primary, enumerate the two Morgan full signatures (at most81^2); conditionally optimize each of the three Ashmole full signatures. F02 has zero contrast weight but remains in allpair/unknown reports. This respects entire-entry constraints without81^5 brute force.
one_primary_quantity.interpretation: Finite drawing-annotation similarity, not name recognition accuracy, species identity or semantics. Shared absences can raise similarity; show per-coordinate contributions and no-information constant-coordinate cases. G1-G4 remain a separately labeled unchanged baseline.

development_and_gate.one_revision: One explicit development revision cycle on fixed K01-K04 only. This proposal is its candidate text. A bounded four-entry operational pass may expose one final written revision; preserve proposal, observations and old failure, rerun/check allfour consistently if definitions change, then freeze. No repeated threshold search or selecting a version for name-score sign.
development_and_gate.development_scores: No K01-K04 same-name score is required for choosing/fixing definitions. Feasibility means local witness/coverage/candidate rules can be used uniformly, not that similar names produce similar signatures.
development_and_gate.before_followup: Another agent reviews the final operation rules, candidate constraints, naming branches/pair roster and primary quantity before root explicitly authorizes F coding. This is internal execution control already required by the goal, not another user authorization request.
development_and_gate.all_six_before_scores: Finish and freeze allsix observability packets before computing H; retain not_reviewed and reviewed_unresolved separately. A defined unit with unknown signature is still retained; a genuinely undefined unit is not replaced by a smaller favorable sample.
development_and_gate.proposed_procedural_calibration_gate: Proposal for root to approve before scoring: allsix units defined under unchanged granularity, nonempty joint domains, no input conflicts, BOTH conditional primary H and prespecified matched-four H4 have rigorously positive lower bounds over the SAME retained joint allowed domain, and independent numerical replay agreement. Report their coupled attainable set or joint witnesses and H-H4 decomposition; separate marginal positive minima over the same domain suffice for uniform positivity, but one cannot combine endpoint values from different completions as one observation. This prevents isolated F01 difference alone from qualifying the procedure; neither quantity rescues the other. Strict literal-name branch is already undefined and remains a limitation; it cannot pass visual-only/unconditional calibration. Positive conditional H/H4 support only conditional procedural continuation. Root must explicitly decide whether that conditional name evidence is sufficient under the goal before authorizing any Voynich coding; this text does not authorize it. Failure or sign-indeterminate bounds for either stops return-to-Voynich scoring.
development_and_gate.return_to_nine: Even if gate passes, require the same frozen operation rules to support allnine original loci and canonical-sharing/candidate contracts. If any scope fails, report allnine deficits and do not choose a subset or modify thresholds.

stop_conditions: Carrier/end-zone/direct-child distinction cannot be made under one written rule without arbitrary new cuts, width threshold or biological axis; retain alternatives/unknown, and after the one allowed revision report operational failure if still required for the intended inference.
False Q0/Q1 absence claims would require unreviewed local regions to be assumed empty; keep unknown instead.
Only local lower records are available and cap-domain bounds remain non-discriminating; report instrument limits, do not demand an impossible exact whole tree.
Input candidate constraints conflict or shared IDs have contradictory values; stop, do not average.
Undefined unit or absent mixed naming branch makes requested full-scope contrast undefined; show all rows and denominator gaps.
Exact joint computation exceeds its predeclared resource cap and no verified bounds are available; label numerical result unresolved.
The predeclared calibration lower-bound gate fails; no new Voynich score.
Stop new long work after17:02:18 UTC and reserve final publication/acceptance by17:17:18 UTC; absolute deadline17:47:18 UTC.
minimum_new_evidence_if_blocked: A locally interpretable carrier/end-zone transition or exact same-source native detail for a specified unresolved port, not a different favorable object.
A coverage receipt establishing a claimed local zero/one child category, or retain{0,1,2}.
A fixed exact-name/source qualification branch if comparison denominators cannot be defined; morphology cannot resolve the naming ambiguity.
current_delivery_boundary: Text and machine-readable proposal only. No images opened, no new K/F states assigned, no pair score computed, no old file modified, no actual source search performed. No novelty claim.

information_loss_and_pre_score_diagnosti.purpose_and_limit: The full local incidence record preserves carrier-zone-child relations and ambiguous ownership that the old four binary features omit. Its capped four-coordinate score is deliberately lossy and is NOT established to be more discriminating. Ease of annotation is not evidence of validity. This proposal can fail as a comparative instrument even when its records are useful.
information_loss_and_pre_score_diagnosti.Q0_saturation: If each of the old K01-K04 terminal witnesses also meets the NEW local no-child and distinct carrier-zone conditions, old lower counts6/6/2/4 imply Q0=2 for allfour. The old counts alone do not establish those new conditions. A constant Q0 contributes exactly0 to H because its distance is0 for every pair; the fixed divisor8 remains and cannot be renormalized after inspection. Thus this coordinate may merely repeat a coarse baseline.
information_loss_and_pre_score_diagnosti.Q1_degree_two_degeneracy: A channel continuing through a degree-two point has no intrinsic carrier/child distinction. Colour or width changes do not rescue Q1. Only a separately delimited cap/attachment region with a visibly distinct outgoing port supports this motif; otherwise merge the uniform trace or retain unresolved alternatives. If every purported Q1 reduces to arbitrary subdivision, Q1 has no admissible positive witnesses and the proposed relation is operationally inadequate. Do not insert new cuts to populate the coordinate.
information_loss_and_pre_score_diagnosti.retained_relation: Q2 distinguishes a carrier ending at a locally bounded zone bearing >=2 directly witnessed free-ending channels from a bare cap. QJ distinguishes an actual local three-arm continuous junction from an opaque body carrying multiple ports. These are incidence/attachment facts, not organ guesses; each still requires witnesses. Different Q2/QJ classifications may describe shared material and are not independent evidence.
counterexamples: EntryU with2 bare caps and EntryV with20 bare caps, no other motifs: both[2,0,0,0], S=1 although raw counts differ tenfold.
EntryU with2 qualifying two-child zones and EntryV with8 qualifying many-child zones, same capped joins and other classes: identical four-vector despite different branching degree and distribution.

Moving identical witnessed motifs among different opaque bodies, or changing their order along a larger structure while preserving four capped totals, can leave S=1. Containment beyond the local relation, global topology and spatial layout are not recovered.

Adding a degree-two marked point on a continuous unbranched path cannot legitimately create Q1. If accepted, the score would measure annotator subdivision rather than drawing relation; such a candidate must be rejected.
information_loss_and_pre_score_diagnosti.algebra: For one mixed stratum, H=(mean_different d - mean_same d)/8 with d=sum_k|z_ik-z_jk|. A fixed constant coordinate cancels exactly; four identical fixed signatures make every S=1 and H=0. If the joint admissible domains contain a single common signature for all compared entries, the all-equal assignment witnesses H=0 and hence no strictly positive robust lower bound is possible. A constant pair-similarity matrix also yields H=0. Shared absence raises raw S but does not by itself yield a positive H.
information_loss_and_pre_score_diagnosti.required_pre_score_diagnostic: After each observation packet freezes, report per-entry domains, each coordinate range, universally constant coordinates, overlap/common-signature feasibility and explicit retained/discarded relations. First diagnose K development without K name contrast. On F apply the same diagnostics before interpreting H; no changed cap, omitted coordinate, adaptive denominator or favorable subset. Do not describe saturation alone as successful hierarchy discrimination.
information_loss_and_pre_score_diagnosti.failure_interpretation: An uninformative or sign-indeterminate H is an instrument limit for this frozen sample. The full relation table can remain useful descriptive evidence, but a successful local annotation exercise does not establish comparative calibration.
